title: Be: am/is/are — Mixed Practice
description: Practice am/is/are with a mix of question types.

questions.question: Be: am / is / are
questions.content: The verb "be" changes with its subject: I am, he/she/it is, you/we/they are. This lesson mixes several question types — multiple choice, select-all, a dropdown, a fill-in-the-blank, a matching task and a word-order task.

questions.question: Which sentences use "are" correctly?
questions.explanation: "Are" goes with you, we and they — not he/she.

questions.question: Complete the sentence: She ___ a doctor. (be)
Match each subject to its form of "be".
questions.explanation: I → am, you/we/they → are, he/she/it → is.

questions.question: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence with "be".
questions.explanation: Word order: subject + be + article + noun.
